title: Wildfire ember-entry check before leaving
summary: Perform only a brief, safe exterior and accessible-interior check for easy ember entry without delaying evacuation.
steps: Close accessible windows and doors, move combustible items from immediate openings, and leave at once if smoke, heat, flame, falling embers, or official orders increase.

title: Wildfire return and hot-spot boundary
summary: Prevent unsafe return while structures, ash, trees, utilities, air, and hidden hot spots remain hazardous.
steps: Return only when authorities allow it, avoid damaged utilities and unstable trees or roofs, and do not disturb ash without appropriate official cleanup guidance.
